definitions.rationale: This rule is the compile-time scanBody macro expansion naming the exact loop-body AST; it defines a proof term and adds no independent execution or mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule scanBody
    => Assign(Name("drops"),
         BinOp("+", Name("drops"),
           Compare(Name("current"), CmpOp("<", Name("previous")))))
       Assign(Name("previous"), Name("current"))

definitions.rationale: This rule is the compile-time moveOneBallBody macro expansion for the exact translated function body, so it is a named structural definition rather than an operational extension.
definitions.text:
rule moveOneBallBody
    => If(UnaryOp("not", Name("arr")),
          Return(Bool(true)),
          .Stmts)
       Assign(Name("first"), Subscript(Name("arr"), Int(0)))
       Assign(Name("previous"), Name("first"))
       Assign(Name("current"), Name("first"))
       Assign(Name("drops"), Int(0))
       For(Name("current"), Name("arr"), scanBody)
       Assign(Name("drops"),
         BinOp("+", Name("drops"),
           Compare(Name("first"), CmpOp("<", Name("previous")))))
       Return(Compare(Name("drops"), CmpOp("<=", Int(1))))

definitions.rationale: This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the allInts domain predicate.
This is the constructor recurrence defining allInts by checking the head and recursively checking the tail.
definitions.text: rule allInts(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq)) => isInt(V) andBool allInts(R)

definitions.rationale: This is the empty-input base equation for the scanDrops accumulator summary.
This is the guarded tail-recursive step equation defining the scanDrops mathematical fold.
definitions.text:
rule scanDrops(D:Int, P:Val, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => scanDrops(
         D +Int (#if {V}:>Int <Int {P}:>Int #then 1 #else 0 #fi),
         V,
         R)
    requires isInt(P) andBool isInt(V)

definitions.rationale: This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the lastAfter structural summary.
This is the constructor recurrence defining lastAfter by advancing to the head and consuming the tail.
definitions.text: rule lastAfter(_:Val, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq)) => lastAfter(V, R)

definitions.rationale: This guarded equation defines moveSpec on the empty sequence.
This guarded equation defines moveSpec on the nonempty all-integer domain in terms of the scanDrops and lastAfter summaries.
definitions.text:
rule moveSpec(VS:ValSeq)
    => scanDrops(0, valSeqAt(VS, 0), VS)
       +Int (#if {valSeqAt(VS, 0)}:>Int
                   <Int {lastAfter(valSeqAt(VS, 0), VS)}:>Int
             #then 1 #else 0 #fi)
       <=Int 1
    requires notBool (VS ==K .ValSeq) andBool allInts(VS)

source_rules.rationale: This simplification rule adds a guarded sort-refinement fact about applyCmp rather than defining a new symbol. Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before all kprove runs and contains no prior exact proof against a module without it.
source_rules.text:
rule applyCmp("<", A:Val, B:Val)
    => {A}:>Int <Int {B}:>Int
    requires isInt(A) andBool isInt(B)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: This simplification rule adds a guarded mathematical fact permitting comparison with lastAfter. Stage 1 uses it in the compiled proof theory and provides no earlier exact proof in a module from which this rule is absent.
source_rules.text:
rule applyCmp("<", A:Val, lastAfter(P:Val, VS:ValSeq))
    => {A}:>Int <Int {lastAfter(P, VS)}:>Int
    requires isInt(A) andBool isInt(P) andBool allInts(VS)
    [simplification]
